label: Galaxy A54 5G smartphone
description: Samsung Galaxy A54 5G — 6.4-inch mid-range phone, Wi-Fi 6 (2.4/5 GHz only) and 5G sub-6 GHz without mmWave; USB-C 2.0 port.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5 GHz) — no 6 GHz, no Wi-Fi 6E, no 160 MHz in some regions. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz only (no mmWave), LTE Cat 18 fallback. USB-C is USB 2.0: Ethernet works through an adapter but is capped near 100M in practice; no DeX. Prime candidate for 'cheap client that squats on 2.4 GHz and never roams to 5 GHz' scenarios.
